sources.observed_relation: ## Goal Recover and implement the Canonical Internalizer / substrate-consumer law and the O* World<->Self recurrent safety contract as executable kernel infrastructure for Safe Strong RSI (#72). ## Canonical source constraints ### Internalizer The surviving structural law is: ```text Constraint -> Internalizer -> ActionGenerator -> Maintainer -> Scaffold -> Constraint' ``` and: ```text Self = internalizer of consequential relation Body = bidirectional WorldMirror substrate ``` with the crucial R193 result: ```text internalize scaffold mediation != internalize World != self-mint fresh return ``` R193 established at bounded engineering scope that scaffold function may migrate into internal capacity while fresh World return remains independently supplied. ### O* Canonical R216 defines O* / Intelligent Love as: ```text DEVELOPMENTAL_RECONSTRUCTION_CONTRACT_NOT_REWARD_FUNCTION ``` with N1: ```text RecursiveSufficiency x NonpreauthoredReturn x CorrigibleContinuation ``` and Strong-N2 constraints: - reconstruct functionally before relying on project labels; - SelfChart and WorldChart are reciprocal indexed presentations of one joint relation; - static state equality is not the fixed point
